title: Business Breakfast | Stock/Share Market News | 13th August 2026 || TV5 Money

recommendations.note: One stock to watch for the next 1 to 1.5 years for buying. Sri City plant will take turnover multi-fold once complete.
recommendations.detail: In his opening market view, while listing the results due that day, Kutumba Rao said to observe LG Electronics carefully. 'This is one stock to watch for the next one year, one-and-a-half years for buying, because their plant at Sri City is coming up magnificently. Once that is complete, turnover will go multi-fold.'

recommendations.price: already up 50% since the Hyderabad workshop idea
recommendations.note: Results as expected. Given as an investment idea at the Hyderabad workshop, already 50% returns. Being added to MSCI index.
recommendations.detail: The anchor noted he had supported Lenskart at IPO time when others mocked it, and that the company had now reported excellent results. Kutumba Rao replied that in terms of results it was expected: 'That is why we gave it as an investment idea, at the Hyderabad workshop itself, and the stock has already given 50% returns since then.' He also flagged Lenskart being added to the MSCI index, with profit up 269% and revenue up 43%.

recommendations.note: Sell on rallies. Best of times are over. Stock weak and profit came in weak.
recommendations.detail: In his market view Kutumba Rao said of IRCTC: 'We have been saying from the beginning, sell on rallies, the best of times are over -- the stock is weak, and we saw profit too come in weak.' He grouped it with the wider railway pack as stocks to be sold into rallies.

recommendations.note: Weak. Best of times are over for railway stocks; these are all stocks to be sold on rallies.
recommendations.detail: Immediately after the IRCTC comment, Kutumba Rao said 'Ircon too is weak. In railway stocks the best of times are over, we have been saying repeatedly -- these are all stocks to be sold on rallies.'

recommendations.note: His large-cap pick when asked for a stock idea for a caller's son's birthday.
recommendations.detail: A caller asked for a mid cap or small cap share to gift his son on his birthday. The anchor asked Kutumba Rao by name for an idea; he was on mute and then unmuted. Asked which large cap he was naming, he said 'L&T. L&T. L&T.' The anchor pushed back that there was no fun in naming L&T and asked for something for the gallery.

recommendations.note: Mid-cap pick for the caller's son. Ice cream company; anchor added valuations are attractive.
recommendations.detail: After first saying he was waiting for the market to correct and that naming something on the spot was not possible for anyone, Kutumba Rao said: 'Vasanth garu, since he said it is for his son, I would say buy Kwality Wall's, Vasanth garu. Kwality Wall's ice cream, Kwality Wall's Limited.' The anchor endorsed it as attractive for the long term in the mid cap space with attractive valuations.

recommendations.note: Hold. The only one of the caller's three loss-making stocks he said to keep.
recommendations.detail: Caller Shruti from Hyderabad said she was 40 to 60% down on Crompton, Container Corporation of India and Sonata Software and asked whether to hold. The anchor directed the question to Kutumba Rao garu by name. He said: 'Container Corporation I would say hold.'
Part of the same question from caller Shruti. Kutumba Rao said the remaining two stocks should be exited on rallies: 'Crompton and Sonata -- exit.'
Part of the same question from caller Shruti. Kutumba Rao said 'Sonata must be exited on rallies.'
